project.name: Waheed Mohamed Eid - Executive CV & Portfolio
project.description: Ultra-professional executive portfolio and interactive CV website with smart case-insensitive visual captcha PDF download, bilingual Arabic/English support, and dark/light mode.

owner.name: Waheed Mohamed Eid
owner.role: Senior Accountant | Accounting Operations & Financial Reporting

frontend.styling: Vanilla CSS3 (Design Tokens, Glassmorphism, CSS Grid & Flexbox, Dark/Light Themes, Print Stylesheet)
frontend.scripting: Vanilla JavaScript ES6+ (Class-based architecture, Web Speech API, IntersectionObserver, Canvas API)

features: Visual noise (bezier curve lines, random color dots, letter rotation & baseline shifts)
Speech synthesis audio challenge (Web Speech API)
Automated PDF CV download on verification

root.index.html: Main entry point, semantic sections, schema, modals, and templates
root.architecture.json: Project architectural definition and metadata specification
root..gitignore: Git exclusion rules for OS and temporary artifacts

css/.style.css: Complete styling system, tokens, layout, dark/light themes, animations, and media queries

js/.translations.js: Bilingual dictionary mapping all UI elements for Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR)
js/.captcha.js: Canvas-based visual captcha generator, audio reader, validator, and PDF downloader
js/.script.js: Main application controller (theme toggle, i18n engine, counter animations, toasts, contact form)

.github/workflows/.deploy.yml: Automated SFTP deployment workflow to Hostinger on push

core_modules.name: Bilingual Internationalization Engine
core_modules.functionality: Instant client-side translation between Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR) using data-i18n attributes with localStorage persistence.

core_modules.name: Executive Theme Controller
core_modules.functionality: Seamless toggling between Midnight Luxury Slate (Dark) and Crisp Slate (Light) themes with localStorage persistence.

core_modules.name: Smart Security Captcha System
core_modules.functionality: Generates distorted alphanumeric codes on HTML5 Canvas, supports case-insensitive entry, provides audio readouts, and triggers verified PDF downloads.

core_modules.name: Career Timeline & Skills Showcase
core_modules.functionality: Structured visualization of 20+ years of senior accounting roles across 6 major enterprises, education credentials, and core financial skills.

core_modules.name: Direct Communication & Toast System
core_modules.functionality: Interactive WhatsApp direct routing, phone/email copy buttons, mailto dispatch, and non-blocking toast notifications.
